evidence: Grep of head src for answer_marker_data/IS_ANSWER_MARKER_KEY/'is_answer' literals: producers are only emit_text.py:96 (data=answer_marker_data() in EmitTextTool.execute) and agent.py:1137,1173, which are the agent's own final-reply components, not Tool.execute results. No other tool (chart, run_sql, memory) sets the key; IS_ANSWER_MARKER_KEY is referenced only in markers.py. Absolute-claim trace: a tool hand-writing data={'is_answer': True} would break it, but no literal 'is_answer' data dict exists outside markers.py/emit_text docs and _format.py's private _is_answer candidate tag (a consumer-side tag, not a tool result). So only emit_text sets answer_prose_emitted at agent.py:1031-1032.

Producers of the marker: answer_marker_data() is called only in agent.py:1137 and :1173 (agent terminal yields and iteration-limit warning, not tool results) and emit_text.py:96 (EmitTextTool). Grep for the literal 'is_answer' / IS_ANSWER_MARKER_KEY across src/sqllens finds no other tool setting the marker (run_sql, emit_chart, agent_memory use metadata, not data is_answer). The only tool-result consumer is agent.py:1031, whose comment matches. Absolute-claim trace: a second tool (e.g. run_sql, emit_chart) returning a component with data is_answer=True would falsify it; no such code exists.

agent.py:998 guards with `if result.ui_component:`; the success branch (else at 1026) is inside it, so line 1031 only runs with a truthy ui_component. UiComponent (core/components.py:14-53) is a pydantic BaseModel with no __bool__/__len__, so any instance is truthy. rich_component is a required field (`...`) and validate_components (line 39) raises unless it is a RichComponent, so the attribute always exists on a constructed instance.

agent.py: answer_prose_emitted is initialized at 667 and assigned only at line 1032, inside the else branch (1026-1032) of `if not result.success` (1000), so only successful results can set it; failed results go through the error branch (1024-1025), which never touches the flag. Grep shows no other assignment. emit_text.py: EmitTextParams._non_empty (39-47) rejects blank text at validation (registry returns success=False before execute); execute's except returns structured_tool_error (_errors.py:31-61), which builds success=False with an unmarked NotificationComponent. So a failed emit_text yields no marked component and does not set the flag. Absolute-claim input traced: blank text -> validation failure -> error branch -> flag unset.

agent.py:667 initialises answer_prose_emitted=False per request. agent.py:1026-1032: only on result.success with a ui_component, if is_answer_marked(rich_component) (markers.py:37-44, strict data['is_answer'] is True) it sets answer_prose_emitted=True; failed results (else branch at 1000) never set it. emit_text.py:93-105 is the only marker producer on a tool result and returns success=True with the marked TEXT; its failure path returns structured_tool_error (no marker). End-of-turn branch agent.py:1121-1141: response.content and answer_prose_emitted -> final reply only logged and saved to history, not yielded; elif response.content -> yielded with answer marker. So the final reply is shown iff no emit_text succeeded. Falsifying input considered: no emit_text success but truncation notice or isError result -> flag stays False, reply shown (matches the claim). Iteration-limit and argument-failure paths (1063, 1144) produce no model final reply; the limit warning is a system message, not the 'final reply' the prompt describes. components_to_blocks (_format.py:352-362) does not itself hide anything; it renders marked TEXTs, consistent with the agent-level rule. Prompt text at default.py:135 matches.

factory.py:163-173 builds UiFeatures(), takes the existing UI_FEATURE_SHOW_TOOL_ARGUMENTS groups, appends DEFAULT_USER_GROUP if missing, and calls register_feature. It passes ui_features into AgentConfig (factory.py:196). The test helper (tests/unit/test_emit_text_final_reply.py:83-98) builds UiFeatures(), registers the same feature with the existing groups plus DEFAULT_USER_GROUP (imported from sqllens.agent.factory), and passes it into AgentConfig(ui_features=...). The only difference is that the test does not dedupe the group. Duplicates have no effect on membership, so the grant is equivalent.

EmitTextParams._non_empty (emit_text.py:39-47) raises ValueError for whitespace-only text. ToolRegistry.execute catches any Exception from args_model.model_validate (core/registry.py:208-218) and returns ToolResult(success=False, error='Invalid arguments: ...'), not an aborting exception. agent.py:1056-1060 counts a round of all-argument-failures as one consecutive failure; the stop threshold is MAX_CONSECUTIVE_ARGUMENT_FAILURES = 3 (agent.py:62), so a single blank emit_text does not stop the loop and the next round (run_sql) resets the counter. The test test_final_reply_shown_after_failed_emit_text_and_recovered_query (tests/unit/test_emit_text_final_reply.py:152-162) scripts _emit('   '), _sql, final reply and expects the reply shown, consistent with this.

criteria.json is a valid list of {criterion,text} objects and carries criterion 1, so it counts. Code: agent.py:1031-1032 sets answer_prose_emitted only when a tool result has result.success and its rich_component is answer-marked (only EmitTextTool marks, emit_text.py:93-105). At agent.py:1121-1126 a non-empty final reply with answer_prose_emitted is only logged (history write at 1109-1116 still happens); the final reply is yielded only in the elif at 1127-1140. An empty reply yields nothing (both branches require response.content). So no final-reply TEXT reaches the stream whether identical, reworded, unrelated or empty (no content-based dedupe). Block builder _format.py:353-362,487-501: marked TEXTs and result_text (one-row results) are emitted in stream order; unmarked text (assistant text alongside tool calls) is dropped because any_marked_text is True once an emit_text block is present; markdown is serialized from the same blocks (532-533). Tests test_emit_text_final_reply.py:119-136 (identical/reworded/unrelated/empty param), 180-195 (one-row result + emit_text, order) confirm. Split conditions: `if response.content and answer_prose_emitted` / `elif response.content`: elif is reached only when no marked success result, which breaks the trigger (a successful emit_text) -> outside the trigger. `result.success` false for emit_text -> outside the trigger (no emit_text succeeded). Iteration-limit warning (agent.py:1144-1178, marked) -> outside the trigger (the model did not end its turn; loop hit the limit). Argument-failure break -> outside the trigger (model did not end its turn). Tool error / truncation paths -> outside the trigger (result is an error / truncation notice excluded by the claim). Sibling behavior: none relied on.

criteria.json is a valid list of {criterion,text}; criterion 2 is this claim. agent.py:667 initializes answer_prose_emitted = False as a request-local variable (comment: never on self), so an emit_text success in an earlier request cannot carry over. It is set True only at agent.py:1031-1032, inside the `else` (result.success) branch at 1026, when is_answer_marked(result.ui_component.rich_component) holds; a failed tool result (1000-1025) never sets it. At the final-reply branch, agent.py:1121 hides the reply only if response.content and answer_prose_emitted; otherwise `elif response.content` (1127-1140) yields a RichTextComponent with the answer marker, so a non-empty reply is shown. Downstream, _format.py:357-359 and 492-495 include marked text as a text block; error results return early at 469-475, matching 'not an error'. Split of the trigger conditions: (a) no emit_text made: flag stays False, reply shown. (b) all emit_text failed, later data query succeeded: failure branch does not set the flag; a data run_sql success result is not answer-marked (the marker is only produced by emit_text.py and the final-reply yield, per the grep of is_answer_marked/answer_marker_data), so it stays False and the reply is shown. (c) only success in an earlier request: the flag is reset per request, so the reply is shown. The empty-content alternative (response.content falsy) is outside the trigger, which requires a non-empty reply. History write at 1109-1116 is unaffected. No departures found.

criteria.json read: valid list, criterion 3 matches this claim (graded with it). agent.py:1108-1116 adds the assistant Message (content=response.content, provider_content) to the conversation before and independent of the hide decision at 1121; the hide branch (1121-1126) only skips the yielded UiComponent and logs. The comment at 1119-1120 states this deliberately. The next request rebuilds from the conversation via _build_llm_request, so the hidden reply is sent as an assistant message. Test tests/unit/test_emit_text_final_reply.py:481-508 drives two requests in one conversation and asserts the hidden text appears in llm.requests[-1].messages exactly once with role assistant, preceded by tool and followed by user. Trigger split: condition `response.content and answer_prose_emitted` (hide) vs `elif response.content` (show); both reach the history write at 1109-1116 first. Alternatives: empty content with provider_content -> history still written (outside trigger: nothing hidden since there is no reply text); empty content and no provider_content -> outside the trigger (no final reply exists to be hidden). No departure found.

Criteria file read; criterion 4 present, so it counts. components_to_blocks (src/sqllens/tools/_format.py:226-552) appends every non-empty TEXT to candidates (353-362) with its marker, then the emission loop (492-497) appends every marked text unconditionally as a block, in stream order. There is no text comparison or dedup anywhere in the function (grep for dedup/seen finds nothing relevant). Identical emit_text texts therefore each yield a block. _trim_blocks_to_budget only trims on size, which is outside the trigger (blocks fit the budget). Split conditions: error_message (469) -> outside the trigger (result is not an error); cand['_is_answer'] false (496) -> outside the trigger because emit_text blocks are marked; not any_marked_text fallback -> only fires when no marked text exists, outside the trigger since emit_text blocks are marked; size trimming -> outside the trigger (fits the budget). The change only suppresses the agent's terminal reply (docstring 252-256) and does not touch emit_text blocks.

criteria.json is a valid {criterion,text} list carrying criterion 5, so it counts. default.py:133-136 (emit_text block): final reply 'is NOT shown once an emit_text call has succeeded in this request. It is shown only when no emit_text call has succeeded'; alongside-tool-call text 'may not be shown to the user: do not rely on the user seeing it' (line 134, hedged but conveys not-shown, and is the intended wording). emit_text.py:62-66 description says the same: alongside-tool-call text 'may not be shown', final reply NOT shown once emit_text succeeds, shown when none succeeds. Grep of both files for hidden/not shown found no statement that all non-emit_text assistant text is hidden. Trigger-condition split: has_emit_text gating (default.py:124) -> the prompt section is only emitted when emit_text is registered, which is the criterion's trigger; no other alternatives produce differing outcomes.

criteria.json is a valid list of {criterion,text}; criterion 6 matches this item. default.py:55 sets has_emit_text = 'emit_text' in tool_names; the block at 124-152 is added only then. Line 135 says the final reply is not shown once an emit_text call has succeeded. Line 136 says: 'once an emit_text call succeeds, every sentence the user must see goes in emit_text - including text the other rules tell you to write in your reply, such as a clarifying question, the plain sentence stating a one-row result, a quoted tool error, or a refusal to describe the schema.' That covers all four named cases. It is consistent with the sources: Ambiguous Questions line 84 (the question is the whole written reply), the one-row rule at line 68 and line 140 (use emit_text for a one-row result), Tool Errors at line 71 (quote verbatim) and Data Confidentiality at line 76 (decline schema requests). Line 136 explicitly overrides where these place text in the reply. Split of the code conditions: (a) `if self.base_prompt is not None: return self.base_prompt` (line 47) -> outside the trigger, because the criterion concerns the prompt the default builder builds and a caller-supplied base prompt is not that; (b) `has_emit_text` false -> outside the trigger, because the trigger is that emit_text is registered. No other alternative gates the line.

criteria.json counts (criterion 7 present, well-formed), so criterion graded with siblings. Updated and consistent: agent.py:1029-1032,1117-1141; markers.py:16-17; emit_text.py:10-12 and tool description 60-66; _format.py:252-256; default.py:133-136; docs/internal/mcp-server/tools.md:133,139,158; docs/internal/agent/factory.md:76. Counterexample: src/sqllens/agent/tools/emit_text.py:83-92 (unchanged by the PR; not in diff.patch) says that without the marker the builder 'excludes it whenever any answer-marked TEXT is present in the stream -- i.e. on every normal multi-block turn (the agent's terminal answer is always marked)'. After the change (agent.py:1121-1126) a turn with a successful emit_text yields no terminal answer, so the stated rationale (a marked terminal answer is present on every normal turn) is no longer true: with emit_text succeeded there is no marked terminal answer, and an unmarked emit_text would survive via the last-unmarked-TEXT fallback in _format.py:477-484.
